testData.templateHint: The object each row shows: each field a fake such as email() or uniform(min=1, max=9)::integer, a nested object, a fixed-length array, or a literal in double quotes for a field that does not vary
testData.stableHint: The same fake on every engine and in every region
testData.stableVersion: Pinned to definition version {{version}}: its values stay the same until its fake changes
testData.stableNoFake: Choose a fake first: only a fake can be stable
testData.stableNever: {{name}}() cannot be stable: it is not computed the same way on every engine
testData.stableNoArguments: A stable {{name}}() takes no arguments: clear them to make it stable
testData.stableNeeds: A stable {{name}}() declares its {{args}}, so it is the same everywhere
testData.savedAsHint: Written from your choice above; edit it to set arguments by hand
testData.unmatchedPii: Tagged pii with no confident match, left for you: {{columns}}.
testData.noConfidentMatch: Tagged pii, with no confident match in the profile: declare its fake.
testData.noProposal: The profile proposes nothing for this column.
